name: Open Exchange Rates API
tagline: Live and historical FX rates for 200+ currencies via a simple JSON API.
description: Open Exchange Rates provides a lightweight HTTPS JSON API for live and historical foreign-exchange rates across 200+ currencies (plus alternatives like BTC and precious metals). Rates are blended from multiple sources and served relative to a base currency (USD on free; any base on paid). Core routes include latest, historical, currencies, time-series, and convert (higher tiers). Auth is a free App ID from self-serve signup.

auth.details: App ID (32-char hex) via query param app_id=YOUR_APP_ID, or Authorization: Token YOUR_APP_ID header. Self-serve free signup at openexchangerates.org/signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Forever Free: 1,000 requests/month; hourly updates; USD base only; daily historical data; no advanced queries (time-series/convert/etc.).
pricing.paid_plans: Developer $12/mo (10k req, all base currencies); Enterprise $47/mo (100k req, 30-min updates, time-series); Unlimited $97/mo (unlimited req, 5-min updates, convert). VIP tiers available.

rate_limits: Monthly soft quotas by plan (free 1k, Developer 10k, Enterprise 100k, Unlimited unlimited). Slight overage not hard-blocked; high usage prompts email/upgrade. Per-second limits not published.
use_cases: get latest USD exchange rates for all currencies
convert a price to multiple currencies for a shopping cart
fetch end-of-day historical rates for a given date
list supported ISO currency codes and names
check remaining monthly API quota for an App ID
pull time-series FX rates over a date range (paid plans)
